item.title: Business, peace, and human rights in high-risk markets
item.content:encoded:
This special issue addresses the complex intersection of business operations, peacebuilding efforts, and human rights protection in challenging geopolitical contexts. The call seeks research examining how corporations navigate and contribute to these interconnected concerns in volatile markets where conflict, instability, or governance challenges create significant risks and ethical dilemmas.

Appel publié par Business Horizons. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Business and peace
  • Human rights
  • High-risk markets
  • Business ethics
